notes.title: Sato's Report: IPU ☆Coming Soon☆ Development Update!

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171361/a604b6770cba33270e52decc96a1703a5db38f24.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Sir![/p][p]This is Sato, your loyal secretary from Cheese Burger Studio![/p][p]Thanks for waiting so long![/p][p]Strange beings have appeared all over the world! (Emergency!!)
[/p][p]So our team has been super busy dealing with them![/p][p]Some of you might’ve faced off against Sister Emily in the demo.
[/p][p]But to purify even more of these mysterious creatures, our Hunter Smith needs to grow stronger—with your help, of course! 😆
[/p][p]We’re working hard to make your hunts smoother and more thrilling.[/p][p]Great news is on the way! 💓
[/p][p]We’ve listened to your feedback from the demo and made major balance updates to IPU.[/p][p](I tagged along for a hunt myself—and wow, it was fun! lol)
